verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs state that a natural-language description produces a working app with frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations, backed by its built-in Cloud backend and chat-driven schema creation. Hands-on community reports confirm working apps: a startup CTO uses it for internal CRUD dashboards, and another user called its app scaffolding 'far better than I expected'. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of production-quality code and architecture for more complex apps (users report a single bloated JS file, 'any' type abuse and poor performance choices), and independent corroboration that generated apps reach launch rather than prototype stage.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: You describe what you want to build, and Lovable generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations, all backed by editable code.
Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.
I recently used lovable to create the scaffolding for an app. It did a great job, far better than I expected.
